层级数据：TreeView 用于浏览和选择（部门、菜单、文件夹），Checkab: Hierarchical data: TreeView browses and selects (departments, menus, folders); CheckableTree multi-selects with cascading checks (permissions, data scopes). Node types extend TreeNode, so your own fields are typed in the callbacks at every depth. There is no built-in search, lazy loading or drag-to-reorder: to search, filter the nodes in the page before passing them in. Node text is shown as is, so translate Chinese in renderLabel / renderText.
节点类型继承 TreeNode 并加上自己的字段；selectedKey 和 o: The node type extends TreeNode with its own fields; the page owns selectedKey and onSelect and shows the details of the selected node.
renderLabel 按类型显示图标和数量；renderActions 悬停时: renderLabel shows an icon and a count by type; renderActions appear at the end of the row on hover, and deleting asks for confirmation with ConfirmAction.
expandedKeys 和 onExpandedChange 一起传，页面就能: Pass expandedKeys together with onExpandedChange and the page can expand everything, collapse everything, or open just the first level.
页面按关键字过滤节点（保留匹配项的上级），展开包含匹配项的分支，并在 rende: The page filters the nodes by keyword (keeping the ancestors of matches), expands the branches that hold matches, and highlights the keyword in renderLabel.
勾选父节点会勾选全部子节点；value 包含全部勾选的节点，半选的父节点不在里面: Checking a parent checks all of its children; value holds every fully checked node, but not half-checked parents: derive those when you need them.
用 FormCustom 把 CheckableTree 接进 react-ho: FormCustom connects CheckableTree to react-hook-form: the checked keys are the field value, and validate requires at least one.
点击左侧的部门查看详情: Click a department to see its details
文件夹「{{name}}」和里面的文件会一起删除。: The folder "{{name}}" is deleted together with its files.
树节点，N 是 TreeNode 或它的子类型: Tree nodes; N is TreeNode or a subtype of it
行内容，默认显示 node.label（不翻译）: Row content; defaults to node.label (not translated)
非受控时初始展开全部节点: Uncontrolled: start with every node expanded
展开 / 收起时调用，传入新的展开列表: Called on expand / collapse with the new list of expanded keys
节点的唯一标识，整棵树内不能重复: The node's identity, unique across the whole tree
子节点，类型和父节点相同，所以自定义字段在每一层都能拿到: Children, of the same type as the parent, so your own fields are there at every depth
树节点，同 TreeView 的 nodes；始终全部展开: Tree nodes, like TreeView's nodes; always fully expanded
勾选的节点（受控）；父节点的 key 会勾选它的全部子节点: The checked nodes (controlled); a parent's key checks all of its children
勾选变化时调用：全部勾选的节点（包括父节点），不含半选的父节点: Called when the checks change: every fully checked node (parents included), without half-checked parents
勾选框后面的文字，默认 node.label: Text after the checkbox; defaults to node.label
点击行或在行上按 Enter / 空格时调用（点箭头只展开 / 收起）: Called on row click, or Enter / Space on the row (the chevron only expands / collapses)
悬停或行获得焦点时显示在行尾的操作，点击不会触发 onSelect: Actions shown at the end of the row on hover or while the row has focus; clicking them doesn't trigger onSelect
让行可勾选：返回勾选状态，读屏报勾选而不是选中（CheckableTree 用它: Makes rows checkable: returns the checked state, which screen readers announce instead of selection (CheckableTree uses it)
树的无障碍名称（中文原文，组件内翻译）；或用 aria-labelledby 指: Accessible name of the tree (Chinese source text, translated inside); or point aria-labelledby at a visible heading
树的无障碍名称（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Accessible name of the tree (Chinese source text, translated inside)
